token_definition: CLI usage input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + output_tokens; includes fixed system context and cached inputs

packet_assisted.population: five synthetic old-evidence questions; no tool choice

agentic_source_available.population: five recoverable synthetic results, one failed result and one missing result; one completed final-head run per case and arm; isolated source directories

agentic_source_deleted.population: one recoverable synthetic result after both arms lose the transcript; scan arm has no index; final-head run

variance_receipt.note: The earlier isolated run scored 7/7 for both arms; the final-head memory arm missed the failed-result case by violating the JSON answer contract. No stability or confidence interval is claimed.

limits: No real long-session sample or frequency estimate.

The packet comparison selects evidence deterministically; it measures answer synthesis.
The agentic comparison tests one model and prompt, one final-head run per case; no confidence interval.
